jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

**Project Overview:**

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections primarily in **C/C++**, as well as in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), Java, Rust, and Go; evaluating and refining AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

**What Does a Typical Day Look Like?**

* Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in **C/C++**, along with Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), Java, Rust, and Go.
* Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.
* Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns.
* Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them.
* Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task.

**Required Skills:**

* Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more).
* Strong expertise in building full-stack applications and deploying scalable, production-grade software using modern languages and tools.
* Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

**Engagement Details:**

* Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week.
* Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
* Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit).
* Location: Candidates must be based out of the US, Canada, or WEU countries (Austria, Belgium, France, Germany).

**Evaluation Process:**

* The application process takes 15-30 minutes.
* Completion of an AI video interview is required.

**Job Title:** Software Developer  
**Company:** SMRTR  
**Location:** United States or Canada, Remote  
**Employment Type :** Full-time

**About SMRTR**

SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections & Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala).

Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product development**

* Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC.
* Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance.
* Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on.

**Integrations and APIs**

* Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns.
* Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print-to-NG driver.

**Delivery and collaboration**

* Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership.
* Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates.
* Support go-lives and help troubleshoot production issues.

**Engineering practices**

* Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub-based workflow with CI/CD.
* Write clear technical documentation and release notes.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to work faster, safely.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 3–5 years of professional software development experience.
* Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js.
* PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance.
* JVM experience, preferably Scala.
* Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third-party systems.
* Git-based workflows, code review and automated testing.
* Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers.
* Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work.

**Nice to Have**

* MongoDB.
* Android or Xamarin.
* ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR).
* Document management, OCR or AI document capture.
* Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food & beverage software.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Features and integrations delivered on schedule
* Quality: defects and production incidents in your code
* Accuracy of estimates on your own work
* Growing ownership of product areas over the year

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location
* Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team

**Recruitment Disclaimer**

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

***We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.***

jobs.title: Lead Systems Software Engineer - Object Storage
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities - Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical lead for the Centennial object storage team while remaining substantially hands-on.

* Lead technical direction and drive key architectural decisions across the team's areas of ownership, including the data path, durability, S3, and data movement.

* Design and build critical components, lead design and code reviews, help engineers solve complex systems problems, and ensure appropriate automated testing and CI coverage for critical changes.

* Mentor engineers and develop technical ownership across the team.

* Partner with the Software Engineering Manager / Product Owner on scope, sequencing, technical risk, and delivery.

**Object Storage Data Path & S3**

* Design, implement, and optimize features in the ActiveScale data path, handling the flow from incoming S3 requests to durable storage across NVMe, HDD, and tape.

* Implement and extend the S3 API, ensuring correct protocol behavior and efficient request handling.

* Improve latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability of the I/O pipeline for exabyte-scale deployments using Linux profiling and systems debugging.

**Durability, Data Placement & Resilience**

* Own complex durability and data-placement work, including two-dimensional erasure coding, and ensure correctness under failures such as node loss, disk faults, partial writes, and network partitions.

* Analyze and optimize concurrency, throughput, and fault tolerance across the request and storage paths.

**Scalability & Data Movement**

* Design and improve systems that move and tier data from high-performance NVMe through HDD to the tape cold-storage tier (ActiveScale Cold Storage).

* Drive the evolution of internal APIs, services, and interfaces that support the data path and data mover.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software development experience using Go, Python, C, C++, or Rust (or equivalent systems-level expertise), with a willingness to learn additional languages.

* Strong experience with distributed systems and high-performance storage software design.

* Strong Linux experience, including systems programming, debugging, profiling, and performance analysis of complex systems.

* Solid understanding of concurrency, synchronization, locking, asynchronous programming, and memory management in performance-sensitive software.

* Understanding of cloud and enterprise storage concepts and the characteristics of storage media such as HDD, SSD, NVMe, and tape.

* Experience with object storage or S3-compatible APIs.

* Demonstrated technical leadership of a team or significant engineering workstream.

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams, including collaboration with the established ActiveScale engineering teams in Belgium.

* This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with the Linux I/O subsystem and networking.

* Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

* Experience with storage protocols and clustering design and development.

* Experience with REST, gRPC, or Thrift.

* Experience with Amazon S3 APIs, SDKs, and tools.

* Familiarity with OCaml is welcome but not required; parts of the existing ActiveScale codebase are written in it.

Quantum provides a diverse portfolio of health plans for medical and prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental medical insurance options. We also support our team members' efforts to develop and maintain a healthy lifestyle through reimbursement and educational programs. Quantum offers a company-matched 401(k) plan to help employees save for retirement in a tax-advantaged way. We also have an Employee Stock Purchase Program for purchasing Quantum stock at a discounted rate.

Anticipated Salary Range: $160,000 to $200,000 for qualified applicants.

The above pay range represents Quantum's good faith and reasonable estimate of possible compensation at the time of posting. Pay within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, relevant experience, knowledge/education, skills/abilities, internal equity, and budgetary considerations.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About RealSelf**

For two decades, RealSelf has been the trusted authority in the aesthetics space. Now, we're evolving into a dynamic digital ecosystem that puts consumers at the center of their aesthetic journey. As the only destination combining verified patient experiences, board-certified doctor insights, and cutting-edge technology, RealSelf empowers millions to make confident, informed decisions.

**Role Overview**

Our NYC-based engineering team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to lead a small but mighty engineering squad, with an initial focus on RealSelf's new booking and finance products.

You will work across the stack, designing and building the backend services that power booking flows, payments, and financial tooling, while setting the technical direction for a team you will help build and grow.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where you will write code, own architecture, and mentor engineers while collaborating with product, design, operations, and finance stakeholders. You'll directly shape how consumers finance and book care, while contributing to the foundation of our next-generation technology platform.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and lead the architecture for RealSelf's booking and finance products infrastructure, including booking and scheduling flows, financing application integrations, and financial collection and reporting pipelines.
* Build and scale backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and SQL that power a high-traffic consumer marketplace used by millions of people researching and booking care.
* Ensure security and compliance across everything that touches money or personal data, including PCI DSS scope reduction, data privacy (GDPR, CCPA), and audit-ready logging.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, and finance to design APIs, data contracts, and reporting feeds used for revenue operations and business decision-making.
* Mentor and guide engineers through code review, architectural reviews, and technical direction.

### **Requirements**

* 7+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering experience, with at least 1+ year in leading a team
* Proven experience designing high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks for financial data (PCI DSS) and privacy (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), infrastructure-as-code tools (CloudFormation, Terraform, or similar), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technically — setting direction, unblocking engineers, and raising the bar through reviews and mentorship.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate code delivery and improve quality.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with product, operations, and finance teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience with experimentation and growth engineering (A/B testing, funnel optimization, conversion instrumentation).
* Previous work in consumer marketplaces, Martech or healthcare tech.

### **Bonus Qualities**

* Hands-on experience with consumer financing providers (Cherry, PatientFi, CareCredit).
* Experience building booking, scheduling, or marketplace systems at scale.

Evaluated based on experience; opportunity for performance-based bonus.

**Why RealSelf?**
-----------------

* RealSelf exists to help people make confident, informed decisions about procedures that can change how they see themselves, and how the world sees them.
* Our reviews are raw and honest. Our Q&A connects people directly with verified experts. We care deeply about trust, safety, and transparency in an industry where those things matter.
* On the heels of a major rebrand, RealSelf is entering a new era of rebuilding and reinvention. This role is an opportunity to help shape the future of a culturally relevant, deeply useful product — and leave a lasting mark on a platform that genuinely matters.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* You'll work alongside our inspiring world-class team to create content and build products that connect and empower millions of people around the world, wherever they may be on their aesthetics journey.
* Health benefits: We offer comprehensive benefits for medical, dental and vision — 100% paid for by RealSelf at the employee level.
* Work-life balance: Enjoy paid time off, including no work on your birthday and Summer Fridays, as well as generous leave options for life events such as becoming a parent.
* 401(k) matching: Plan for the future and take advantage of our 401(k) plan with a company match.
* Treatment reimbursement: At RealSelf, we encourage our team to walk in our audience's shoes. That's why we offer a cosmetic treatment reimbursement program to employees who would like to take on a more active role as the consumer.
* Company holidays: We believe in celebrating holidays! Enjoy time off during our 12 company-wide holidays + no work on your birthday!
* Hybrid NYC office: We recognize that there's no one size fits all with office culture. That's why we believe in a flexible hybrid schedule for our New York City employees, who can enjoy the benefits of in-person collaboration in our office as well as deep work time while remote at home.

  

* *Compensation will be evaluated based on experience.*

RealSelf is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

**More About RealSelf**
-----------------------

* Beautymatter: RealSelf's New “Omnichannel Content Flywheel” Is Quickly Paying Off
* Forbes: Inside RealSelf’s Rebrand
* Adweek: Cosmetic Surgery Platform RealSelf Appoints New CEO to Spur Editorial

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description:
*Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.*

Robotics Software Engineer - Construction

**Job Description:**
====================

The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof-of-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites.

This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who has a deep system-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof-of-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field-ready solution.

We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Robotics Software & Systems Integration

* Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications.
* Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack.
* Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems.
* Develop field-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning.
* Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities.
* Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution.
* Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk.
* Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks.
* Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected.

Collaboration & Partnerships

* Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders.
* Integrate and extend third-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces.
* Contribute to co-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions.

Field Testing & Deployment

* Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects.
* Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities.
* Design for difficult real-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change.
* Support deployed systems through remote and on-site troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or 2+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems.
* Proficiency in C++, Python, and Linux-based robotics development.
* Proficiency in modern software-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
* Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution.
* Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
* Strong system-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations.
* Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast-moving environments and take ownership of open-ended technical problems.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects.
* Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real-world environments.
* Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) or comparable robotics middleware.
* Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots.
* Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems,

jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a full-stack engineer with focus on infrastructure to build the tools and systems that help Pramaana’s engineers and researchers develop, test, deploy, and operate their work more effectively.

Your initial focus will be **DevOps and MLOps**: improving development environments and deployment workflows, making experiments and evaluations reproducible, and helping teams understand the behavior, performance, and cost of AI systems. You’ll build across interfaces, backend services, and infrastructure automation—not just maintain scripts or configure dashboards.

This is an early-stage role with scope across the company. As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self-serve tools.

We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Improve how software gets built and deployed.** Develop repeatable local environments, automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows. Help make configuration, secrets, releases, and rollbacks easier to manage safely.
* **Build tools for the AI development lifecycle.** Create workflows for running experiments and evaluations, versioning datasets and configurations, tracking results and artifacts, and deploying or integrating model services. Make runs easier to reproduce, compare, and investigate. Help researchers get from a recipe to a running job, and from a failed job to the cause..
* **Create full-stack, self-serve applications.** Build interfaces and APIs that let teams launch jobs, manage configurations, inspect results, and troubleshoot failures without relying on repeated manual assistance.
* **Make systems observable and costs understandable.** Connect logs, metrics, traces, and usage data so teams can diagnose issues, identify bottlenecks, and understand where time and compute are being spent.
* **Contribute to shared platform services.** Help build and integrate identity, access controls, LLM routing, API keys, budgets, and usage metering across Pramaana’s products and internal workflows.
* **Use existing tools thoughtfully.** Evaluate and extend open-source or managed solutions where they fit. Build custom software where it solves a real gap, rather than recreating infrastructure unnecessarily.
* **Improve tools through direct feedback.** Work alongside engineers and researchers to identify recurring problems, prioritize improvements, and measure whether tools reduce setup time, manual work, and failed runs. Maintain tests, documentation, and operational guidance for what you ship.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* **Minimum 2-3 years of software engineering experience**, including hands-on work with backend services, full-stack applications, internal tools, or deployment automation.
* **A solid foundation in building software across the stack.** You can develop services and automation in Python or TypeScript, work with APIs and databases, and build usable interfaces with React or a similar framework.
* **Practical cloud and deployment experience.** You’ve deployed applications using containers and a cloud platform such as AWS, worked with CI/CD, and used logs or metrics to investigate problems.
* **Some hands-on exposure to AI or ML workflows.** This could include integrating model APIs, running evaluations, tracking experiments, or operating model-backed applications through work or substantial projects. You don’t need to be an ML researcher.
* **A product mindset for internal users.** You care about clear interfaces, sensible defaults, useful documentation, and reducing the number of steps it takes someone to get their work done.
* **Good engineering judgment and a collaborative approach.** You write maintainable code, test important behavior, ask for review, and communicate trade-offs. You can take ownership of a scoped problem while recognizing when to seek help.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience with experiment tracking, evaluation pipelines, workflow orchestration, or model observability using tools such as MLflow, Langfuse, or Temporal.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or telemetry tooling, such as Terraform, Kubernetes, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes: job queueing and preemption multi-node training with NCCL over EFA or InfiniBand, GPU node health and driver management, or serving models with vLLM or SGLang.
* Experience implementing authentication, role-based access, API-key management, image provenance, LLM gateways, usage and cost tracking or hardening public endpoints.
* Experience adapting open-source software or building developer tools that other engineers or researchers use regularly.

**About the Role**

Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next.

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am.

This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software & Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets.

This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You're a full-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009. You likely:

* Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break.
* Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration.
* Have worked with real time-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time.
* Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things.
* Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it.

**What You'll Do**

**Product and front end**

* Build operator-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power-flow visualizations.
* Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails.
* Keep large, data-dense views fast and responsive across devices.

**Data ingestion and integrations**

* Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model.
* Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources.
* Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill.

**Time-series platform**

* Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention.
* Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows.
* Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes.

**Quality and operations**

* Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing.
* Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on-call as the platform scales.

**Why Teserac**

We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations.

* Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed.
* Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions.
* Work where AI, real-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet.
* Grow with the company from Series A through scale.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Required**
* + 7+ years building and shipping production software across the stack
  + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days.
  + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database
  + Practical time-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time-series or high-volume streaming store transfers.
  + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data-heavy interface fast
  + Experience with asynchronous and event-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets
  + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core.
  + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship
* **Preferred**
* + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources
  + Hands-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs
  + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE
  + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal
  + Early-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B
* Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply.

  
**Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
* Free Food & Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* 401(k)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

GripFusion is building the next generation of sports performance technology with Tactile Intelligence. As our Forward-Deployed Software Engineer, you will expand every surface where GripFusion meets the athlete, from the ForceBall to the iPad, mobile, and web experiences that turn tactile data into decisions.

This is a product-facing engineering role reporting to Will Shawn, Head of Software. You will work across the full stack, spend time with players and coaches to understand how they use novel tactile data, and turn what you learn into shipped product. You will bring design and athlete thinking to every decision.

You will work alongside our product, embedded, data science, and design teams to build new visualizations, connect GripFusion to the systems our customers already use, and carry common design practices across our baseball and golf platforms.

**What You'll Build**
---------------------

* **The iPad app.** Extend and harden our primary product, built in React Native on an AWS backend and used by teams today.
* **The web dashboard.** Build a new React dashboard where coaches and staff review sessions, compare athletes, and share insights.
* **The mobile** **app.** Build a mobile app that communicates directly with the ForceBall and supports broader use cases at the field.
* **Novel visualizations.** Invent new ways to show tactile and athlete data, including 3D graphics that make the invisible obvious.
* **Integrations.** Pull in data from the other systems teams already use, so GripFusion fits naturally into their workflow.
* **The golf platform.** Contribute to our golf product and carry common design patterns and components across baseball and golf.

* Work across the full stack, from BLE device communication and cloud services to mobile and web interfaces.
* Partner with players, coaches, and team staff to understand user needs and how they interact with tactile data.
* Balance quick prototyping and discovery with production-level engineering, testing, and deployment.
* Work with design to shape the user experience, and establish shared design practices across verticals.
* Partner with embedded and data science to define device data transmission, state handling, and data formats.
* Visit MLB teams to test with athletes and coaches, and bring product thinking back to the software stack.
* Use AI development tools every day, and help shape how the software team builds with them.

**Desired Skills & Qualifications**
-----------------------------------

* 4+ years shipping production software across mobile and web, ideally with React Native, React, and TypeScript.

* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows.

* Experience integrating third-party data sources and APIs (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **An owner.** You take product and technical ownership end to end, from first conversation to shipped feature.
* **A builder who explores.** You love quick prototypes and discovery, but you know when a prototype needs to become a product.
* **Product- and design-minded.** You care about how an experience feels, not just whether it works.
* **An athlete at heart.** You have competed or coached, and you understand how players train, compete, and take feedback.
* **A great communicator.** You are as comfortable in a clubhouse with players and coaches as you are in a code review.

This role is designed to grow with the company. You will shape how GripFusion shows up for athletes and coaches across every surface we build. **Work Environment**
--------------------

* Full-time, in-person role based at GripFusion's Performance Lab headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, including our in-house pitching lab, with up to 10% travel to MLB/NCAA teams and partners.
* Collaborative, innovation-first startup environment working across hardware, firmware, software, design, and data science.

* Family first, with a close-knit team that enjoys solving hard problems.

Agentic Pods is building a new model for how Engineering partners with teams across Uber to transform work with AI. Our engineers embed directly with operational teams to understand complex workflows, reimagine how that work could operate in an agentic-first world, and build the production systems that make that future real.  
  
We are looking for an Agentic Software Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade agentic systems and processes that improve complex operational workflows.  
  
This role combines backend engineering, reliability engineering, and a forward-deployed working model. You will work directly with operators and domain experts to discover opportunities, determine where agents can safely help, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable software.  
  
You will own solutions from discovery through architecture, implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation.  
  
**What You Will Do**  
  
**Discover and Build Agentic Systems**  

* Embed with operational teams to understand workflows and identify where agentic AI, deterministic software, automation, or human decision-making can meaningfully improve how work gets done.
* Design, build, and iterate on production agentic systems, including agents, skills, backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and human-in-the-loop workflows, alongside real users.

  
**Own Production Reliability**  

* Define reliability and quality targets and build observability across agent decisions, model behavior, dependencies, and workflow outcomes through tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, fallbacks, and recovery.
* Own systems in production, using incidents, operational data, and user outcomes to continuously improve performance, resilience, and reliability.

  
**Make Agents Safe and Measurable**  

* Define evaluations and validation approaches for task completion, output quality, tool selection, policy compliance, and failure handling across offline testing, controlled rollouts, and production monitoring.
* Build appropriate controls—including permissions, approvals, auditability, data minimization, reversible execution, and human escalation—and partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Data to ensure consequential actions are safe, explainable, and recoverable.

  
**Build for Reuse and Scale**  

* Identify capabilities that should become reusable skills, shared services, platform components, or standard integration patterns, supporting business and regional differences through configuration rather than unnecessary system forks.
* Establish common contracts and contribute to architecture, tooling, deployment patterns, reliability practices, and technical standards that enable Agentic Pods to build and scale consistently.

  
**Who Thrives on This Team**  
  
We're looking for engineers with strong technical depth who are comfortable operating in ambiguity and working directly with users.  

* **Agentic-first thinker:** You naturally look for opportunities to redesign workflows around what's newly possible.
* **0 1 builder:** You move quickly from ambiguous problems to working software.
* **Product-minded:** You have strong judgment about what is useful and worth building, not just what is technically possible.
* **Systems thinker:** You recognize when individual solutions should become reusable capabilities or standards.
* **Adaptable communicator:** You learn unfamiliar domains quickly, build trust, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

  
**Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field OR 1-year full-time Software Engineering work experience, WHICH INCLUDES 1-year total technical software engineering experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + Programming language (e.g., C, C++, Java, Python, or Go).
* *Note: The 1-year total of specialized software engineering experience may have been gained through education and full-time work experience, additional training, coursework, research, or similar (or some combination of these). The year of specialized experience is not necessarily in addition to the years of education and full-time work experience indicated.*
* Strong experience designing and building production backend or distributed systems, including agentic applications, AI-enabled workflows, orchestration systems, developer platforms, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and system integrations.
* Experience owning and improving production systems, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, failure recovery, and debugging across application, infrastructure, and data dependencies.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience integrating LLMs with tools, APIs, enterprise data, and permissioned systems.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation, retrieval, context management, model routing, and safety controls.
* Experience in SRE, infrastructure, platform, production engineering, or a forward-deployed/embedded engineering model.
* Experience designing systems for sensitive or operationally consequential workflows.
* Ability to lead technical design, drive key architectural decisions, and influence technical direction across teams.

  
Deep AI research experience is not required. We value engineers who can apply emerging agent technologies within secure, reliable production systems.  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

**Job description**

**Job Title**: Junior Software Engineer (Full-Time, Onsite)

As a Junior Java Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web applications using Java, front-end technologies, and a range of modern frameworks and tools. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, back-end engineers, and designers, to build and optimize scalable, high-performance applications.

* Implement server-side logic, database interactions, and business logic.
* Integrate with third-party APIs and services as required.
* Ensure the application is optimized for speed and scalability.
* **Front-End Development**:
* Build responsive user interfaces using **JavaScript** and modern frameworks like **React**, **Angular**, or **Vue.js**.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to deliver seamless user experiences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code for the front-end.

* Follow best practices in Agile development (Scrum, Kanban) to iterate and improve product features.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**:

* **Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

* Solid understanding of **HTML5**, **CSS3**, and **JavaScript**.

* Knowledge of version control systems like **Git**.
* Familiarity with **Docker** and containerization, as well as **CI/CD** pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as **AWS**, **Google Cloud**, or **Azure**.
* Ability to write clean, testable, and efficient code.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
* Good understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**:

* Experience with **microservices** architecture.
* Familiarity with message brokers like **Kafka** or **RabbitMQ**.
* Experience with **GraphQL** or **RESTful services**.
* Knowledge of **unit testing** frameworks (e.g., **JUnit**, **Mockito**).

**Benefits**:

jobs.description:
**Location:** Clearwater, Florida (Onsite)  
**Company:** Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions

### **About Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions**

Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is a fast-growing Defense technology company headquartered in Clearwater, Florida. Founded by US and UK veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real-world employment of unmanned systems.

Marcurius is building a new kind of unmanned systems company – multi-domain, multi-platform, and mission-driven. We fuse battle-proven technologies, resilient command-and-control architectures, and operator-led doctrine to deliver capabilities that work in contested environments. Our initial focus is the rapid fielding of advanced Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) for modern maritime operations.

### **Role Overview**

We're looking for a motivated, curious, and hands-on **Junior Software Engineer** to join our growing engineering team at Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions.

In this role, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to develop, integrate, and test software supporting our advanced unmanned and autonomous systems. You'll contribute across a range of technologies, from software development and embedded systems to robotics, autonomy, and hardware integration.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building things, solving technical challenges, and learning new technologies. You don't need to be an expert in every area, but you should have strong programming fundamentals, a practical problem-solving mindset, and the drive to take ownership of your work.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, test, debug, and maintain software components using Python, C++, or other relevant technologies.
* Support software development and integration for unmanned and autonomous maritime systems.
* Collaborate with software, hardware, and systems engineers to solve technical challenges.
* Contribute to embedded software development and integration with microcontrollers, sensors, and onboard systems.
* Support robotics, autonomy, and machine learning-related development activities.
* Assist with frontend interfaces, databases, and supporting software tools as needed.
* Participate in hardware/software integration, prototype development, and system testing.
* Troubleshoot software issues, investigate root causes, and implement improvements.
* Maintain clear code documentation and follow established development and version control practices.
* Take ownership of assigned development tasks while supporting broader engineering projects.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong programming fundamentals with practical experience in **Python or C++**.
* Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.
* Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and troubleshoot software through academic, personal, or professional projects.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Interest in working across software development, embedded systems, and hardware integration.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers while independently managing assigned tasks.

Recent graduates and early-career engineers with strong technical projects are encouraged to apply.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded systems, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms.
* Interest in or exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, or machine learning.
* Experience with frontend development, databases, Git, or software development tools.
* Personal software projects, GitHub repositories, or hands-on engineering projects demonstrating technical curiosity and initiative.

### **Work Environment**

* Onsite engineering and integration environment.
* Direct involvement in prototype development and system testing, including sea trials.
* Fast-paced development cycles with aggressive timelines.
* Close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Customer, end-user, and internal team-facing activities.

### **Why Marcurius**

Marcurius is a people-first, execution-focused organization assembling a high-impact team of Engineers and Operators. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape real-world systems, support strategic national security priorities, and be part of an incredibly exciting journey - building the foundations of a next-generation Defense technology company.

### **Equal Opportunity Employment**

Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse, mission-driven team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

We strongly encourage applications from veterans and individuals with experience in maritime, defense, communications, and advanced technology sectors.

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer - Object Storage
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Object Storage Data Path & S3**

* Contribute to features in the ActiveScale data path, helping handle the flow from incoming S3 requests to durable storage across NVMe, HDD, and tape.

* Contribute to the implementation and extension of the S3 API, ensuring correct protocol behavior and efficient request handling.

* Analyze and help improve the latency, throughput, and reliability of the I/O pipeline, developing your Linux profiling and systems-debugging skills as you go.

**Durability, Data Placement & Resilience**

* Contribute to durability and data-placement work, including erasure coding, and help ensure correctness under failures such as node loss, disk faults, and partial writes.

* Help analyze and improve concurrency and throughput across the request and storage paths.

**Scalability & Data Movement**

* Contribute to the systems that move and tier data from high-performance NVMe through HDD to the tape cold-storage tier (ActiveScale Cold Storage).

**Engineering**

* Write clean, well-tested code with unit, component, and integration tests, use CI, take part in design discussions and code reviews, and grow toward independent ownership of components under the guidance of senior engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software development experience using Go, Python, C, C++, or Rust (or equivalent systems-level fundamentals), with a willingness to learn additional languages.

* Hands-on software development experience with concurrent, networked, distributed, or systems-level software.

* Solid Linux fundamentals, including basic debugging and performance analysis, with a willingness to develop deeper profiling and systems-debugging skills.

* Understanding of the basics of concurrency, locking, asynchronous programming, and memory management.

* Understanding of cloud or enterprise storage concepts and familiarity with storage technologies such as HDD, SSD, and NVMe, with an interest in learning about multi-tier storage systems.

* Good communication skills; ability to work in a team environment and with remote colleagues.

* Self-motivated and eager to learn, with a creative problem-solving mindset.

* This is a hybrid role, with in-office work at our Centennial, CO office Tuesday through Thursday.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with the Linux I/O subsystem and networking.

* Knowledge of erasure coding principles.

* Experience with object storage.

* Experience with storage protocols and with clustering design and development.

* Experience with APIs and communication protocols such as REST, gRPC, or Thrift.

* Familiarity with OCaml is welcome but not required; parts of the existing ActiveScale codebase are written in it.

* Experience with the Amazon S3 API, SDKs, and tools.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
jobs.description:
Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi-stage work reliably and at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users.

The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress.

The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM-backed applications, AI agents, or agent-based systems in production**.

You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems.

**Remote Work Eligibility**  
This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.**

Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements.

The engineering problems addressed by this team include:

* **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long-running, multi-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work.
* **Multi-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover.
* **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi-step work.
* **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior.
* **Testing non-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior.
* **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured-output validation, automated evaluation, domain-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output.
* **Human-in-the-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution.
* **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets.
* **Production service architecture:** Go-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user-facing applications.
* **Secure ingestion:** Processing user-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries.

### **Two Engineering Emphases**

Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas:

### **Platform and Pipeline**

Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed-systems and reliability challenges.

### **Agents and Quality**

Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end-to-end output quality.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement.

Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required.

### **Essential Functions**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate **production-quality software and backend services**, primarily using **Go (Golang)**.
* Architect and build **AI agents and agent-based systems** capable of using tools, interacting with APIs, maintaining state and context, and executing complex multi-step workflows.
* Design durable workflows that can **checkpoint, resume, retry, recover, and safely continue execution following partial failures or system interruptions**.
* Determine how **models, agents, tools, APIs, data sources, services, and deterministic application logic** should divide responsibilities within an AI system, including recognizing when an AI model is not the appropriate solution.
* Design integrations across multiple AI model providers, including routing, failover, rate-limit management, health monitoring, and degradation strategies.
* Build safeguards including structured-output validation, error handling, retries, quality gates, evidence validation, and automated recovery mechanisms.

jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for software engineers who want to solve meaningful technical problems, contribute to systems at scale, and help shape what we build next.  
  
We work in an agile environment with two-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. From day one, you'll contribute directly to the codebase and collaborate with experienced engineers from a wide range of leading universities and technology companies.  
  
We are looking for an engineer to help build and evolve Yext's **Knowledge Graph** product turning customer information into a connected, usable source of truth. You'll work on the core infrastructure, APIs, and workflows that help brands model, manage, and connect their knowledge across products and experiences.  
  
The work involves challenging engineering problems, including representing complex real-world entities, processing large volumes of changing data, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that allow other teams to build confidently on top of the graph. This is an opportunity for engineers who enjoy foundational technology, thoughtful data modeling and system design, and seeing their work enable a wide range of customer experiences.  
  
This role is based in our New York City office, where in-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing operation
* Contribute to the design, implementation, and deployment of highly scalable and reliable systems
* Develop storage systems, libraries, and frameworks
* Proactively contribute ideas for new features and identify opportunities to improve our products, systems, and engineering practices
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across engineering and with partners throughout the company
* Write clean, tested, and well-documented code
* Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate engineering work, explore solutions, improve code quality, and reduce repetitive tasks
* Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated output rather than treating it as inherently correct
* Maintain ownership of all work produced with AI assistance, including its correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with our engineering standards

**What You Have**

* A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent college-level education
* 1+ years of professional software engineering experience
* A strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Fluency with Java, C++, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Java and Go)
* Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment
* The ability to evaluate technical solutions critically, including code and recommendations produced by AI tools
* Experience using—or a demonstrated interest in learning—AI-assisted development tools as part of a responsible engineering workflow
* Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools

jobs.title: Mid level Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

You will design, build, and operate production-grade multi-agent systems for commercial and federal customers. The work spans the LangChain ecosystem, reliable agent loops, advanced retrieval architectures, and ontologies that ground agent reasoning.

You will also connect agents to enterprise tools and to each other through MCP and A2A. This role suits an engineer who thinks in systems: how agents reason, retrieve, act, recover from failure, and get evaluated and observed in production.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Agent development and orchestration

* Build single- and multi-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets.
* Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably.
* Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache-Augmented Generation with semantic caching.
* Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, and query-rewriting strategies.
* Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance.

Ontologies, context, and skills

* Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG.
* Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window.
* Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning.

Interoperability protocols

* Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely.
* Implement Agent-to-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross-vendor communication.

Engineering and delivery

* Write production-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
* Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM-powered applications.
* Hands-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith.
* Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning.
* Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows.
* Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol.
* Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming.
* Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations.

Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Forecasting sits underneath much of North: projected spend, budgets, and the commitment purchases we make on customers' behalf all depend on knowing where a customer's usage is headed. When a forecast is off, customers feel it, either in missed savings or in commitments that go unused.

You'll join the Services team and own the models behind North's internal forecasting service, working with your teammates on the service that delivers forecasts across North's features. You'll shape how the service evolves, from how models are trained and evaluated to how forecast quality is monitored in production. jobs.title: AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

More and more PlanetScale databases are created, connected and queried by AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and a growing list of other tools now sit between developers and their infrastructure.

You will own that experience end to end. You'll make sure PlanetScale shows up everywhere developers build with AI, that our MCP server and CLI work flawlessly in every agent, and that we can measure how well it all works. Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences.

This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs.

The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure.

**Make PlanetScale great with AI tools**
----------------------------------------

* Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders
* Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms
* Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one
* Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do
* Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team
* Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on
* Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale
* Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and PlanetScale

**Measure how well we're doing**
--------------------------------

* Build evals that run real agent tasks against PlanetScale databases
* Benchmark how agents perform with PlanetScale and work towards continuous improvement
* Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate
* Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail

**Show people how to do it well**
---------------------------------

* Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best
* Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment
* Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI

**These attributes best describe you**
--------------------------------------

* Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them
* Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use
* Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line
* Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation
* Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials
* Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production
* Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise
* Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage
* Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it
* Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers
* Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
* Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents
* Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product
* A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow
* Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale
  

### **Why PlanetScale**

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $220,000
