jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Engineer reports to the Head Scientist and builds and maintains the systems that let the team's scientists run their studies correctly, reproducibly, and at scale. The scientists design the studies and define the measurements; you make sure every experiment executes exactly as designed, that results can be reproduced from stored inputs, and that research code stays in step with the shipped product. The ideal candidate has supported scientists in an academic computational social science lab or a comparable research setting and has hands-on experience engineering systems built on large language models.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the evaluation infrastructure that tests competing modeling approaches, so that new tests can be set up quickly, run concurrently and automatically, and be monitored.
* Implement measurement pipelines exactly as specified by the scientists, with deterministic and traceable outputs.
* Maintain versioned evaluation datasets with held-out sets that are never used for training.
* Build and maintain data pipelines for human-participant data, external datasets, and model training data, including linkage of records belonging to the same participant across sources.
* Keep research code in step with the production product so that validated improvements ship promptly.
* Detect and prevent threats to the validity of evaluations.
* Track compute and API spend across experiments and their implications for production-stage costs
* Manage repositories, code review, documentation, and the reproducibility of the team's coding workflow.
* Identify implementation choices that can be made more correct or more efficient, and propose changes.

**Qualifications**

* Several years of software engineering experience, including experience supporting researchers in a lab or comparable setting.
* Experience translating specific scientific requirements and experiment designs into code.
* Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines on human behavior data, and confirming that the pipelines matched the criteria and design the researchers specified.
* Strong Python, including the ability to read and audit code produced by agentic coding tools.
* Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, tabular data, and Git-based workflows.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and with running many jobs concurrently.
* Working understanding of machine learning, including how transformer-based language models behave, how model APIs are used, and what fine-tuning involves.
* A habit of writing deterministic, reproducible, cost-aware, and well-documented code.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Hands-on experience engineering large language model systems: prompt pipelines, evaluation harnesses, embedding computation, agentic systems, and/or fine-tuning infrastructure.
* Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on multi-GPU hardware.
* Experience serving open-weight models with an inference framework such as vLLM or SGLang, including batched inference and prefix caching for many requests that share a common prompt.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads.
* Experience with survey or panel data and data collection platforms.
* Experience extracting and storing model activations for downstream analysis.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads, including GPU provisioning across cloud providers.
* Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

**About Intuitive Machines:**

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

Our long-term partnership with NASA has created an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer on the JETS II contract at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX. Hybrid telework is preferred, with remote candidates also considered.

**About the Position:**

NASA’s Front Door (NFD) program is seeking a Data Engineer to support enterprise data architecture, database design, data connections, and data integrity for NASA’s external engagement platform. This role helps build and maintain the data foundation that enables intake workflows, CRM operations, analytics readiness, and cross-agency data interoperability.

**The work**

We are seeking to build a team to implement LLM models into our current analytic environment. This role ranges from Senior to Junior level Software/Data Engineers to provide hands-on application engineering: agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, tool integration, and the backend services that hold it together, deployed into a classified enterprise environment.

**What you’ll do**

Work varies with experience, but expect a mix of:

*Build agent components.* Implement orchestration logic, tool integrations, and memory handling within agent-based applications with design support early on and increasing ownership as you go.

*Work the retrieval pipeline.* Document processing, embedding generation, retrieval configuration, prompt assembly. This is where most people learn what actually makes RAG work, and where you’ll spend real time.

*Write the services.* Python REST APIs supporting data retrieval, system integration, and agent workflows.

*Handle the data.* Process and transform structured and unstructured data for AI workflows; work with Postgres schemas and query performance.

*Ship to production.* Testing, deployment, and the enterprise realities of a classified environment.

**Junior-level**

We’re looking for a working software engineer who wants to move into AI. You should bring:

* Solid Python, with real production code behind you
* Experience building or consuming REST APIs
* Comfort with databases and SQL
* *Some* hands-on exposure to LLMs or a RAG prototype, an agent you wired up, a side project, a course. Curiosity you can point at, not a credential
* Bachelor’s in computer science or a related field (additional experience considered in lieu)

You do not need prior professional AI work. We’ll teach the domain.

**Mid-level**

Same foundation, plus you’ve shipped something AI-enabled:

* Hands-on work building LLM-integrated applications, RAG workflows, or retrieval-based systems
* Working familiarity with agent concepts for at least one AI framework
* Understanding of the fundamentals: how transformers behave, why context windows matter, where retrieval breaks down
* Enough production experience to have opinions about reliability and maintainability

**Senior-level**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience overall with recent hands-on work building AI/ML applications
* Bachelor’s in computer science or a related field
* Strong Python and fluency with common data and AI libraries

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Engineer  
Mid-Level | Dallas, TX (Hybrid) | Full-Time

WHO WE ARE

Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) is a Dallas-based AI software development firm that helps businesses achieve AI sovereignty and get off the SaaS treadmill. We don't believe in renting someone else's roadmap. We believe in building solutions purpose-built for each client's business, powered by the latest in agentic AI and intelligent automation.

We work across industries, including manufacturing, construction, investment management, and hospitality, helping organizations use agentic technology to transform how they operate. Our engagements range from replacing bloated SaaS stacks with custom AI-driven workflows to building multi-agent systems that automate entire business processes.

At CV.AI, we see agentic development and vibe coding as personal multipliers. Agents represent a fundamental shift in how software gets built and delivered. Our team members respond, “I'll get my agent on that,” for everything from architecture design to task updates. If that mindset resonates with you, keep reading.

POSITION DETAILS

Job Title: AI Engineer  
Level: Mid-Level  
Employment Type: W2, Full-Time  
Location: Hybrid — Dallas, TX (Galleria / Addison area)  
Reports To: VP, AI Engineering  
Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for a mid-level AI Engineer who uses AI agents as a personal force multiplier to architect, test, document, and ship production-grade solutions for our clients.

You'll work on client engagements across industries, translating business requirements into agentic workflows, deploying intelligent systems, and ensuring every deliverable meets enterprise standards for security, scalability, and repeatability.

You'll also regularly interact with clients, explaining technical deliverables clearly and confidently. You'll work alongside senior engineers and engagement leads in small, fast-moving teams where every team member has an outsized impact.

To meet our clients' requirements, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. An offer of employment may be contingent on a background check.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions, from single-agent workflows to multi-agent orchestration, with agents serving as core functionality, user interfaces, or both.
* Use spec-driven and test-driven development practices with AI agents to produce reliable, secure, tested, and well-documented code.
* Identify and bring new applications of AI to our clients' businesses.
* Evaluate agent-produced code for quality, security, and alignment with client requirements.
* Build and integrate client-facing applications that embed AI capabilities where users work, replacing manual processes and legacy SaaS tools.
* Contribute to agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory architectures, and shared human-agent wikis.
* Document architectures, decision criteria, integration patterns, and deployment configurations to support knowledge transfer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of production deployments.
* Experience using AI agents, coding assistants, or agentic frameworks to deploy production-grade code at a company or for a client.
* Experience with spec-driven and test-driven development workflows.
* Ability to critically evaluate agent-produced code and identify hallucinations, security gaps, and quality issues before deployment.
* A strong focus on security, scalability, repeatability, and well-documented deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort presenting technical deliverables and progress directly to clients.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD workflows.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Dallas offices in the Galleria / Addison area.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience building or implementing agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory systems, or wikis designed for shared human-agent use.
* Hands-on experience integrating computer vision technologies into production systems.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or equivalent, and prompt engineering patterns.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI, and integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client-embedded delivery.
* Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
* Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or both.

THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring for technical skills and a way of thinking. The right candidate sees AI agents as teammates. When a problem lands on your desk, your instinct is to consider which agent can help tackle it, whether that means writing tests, researching an API, scaffolding a service, or reviewing a pull request.

You're curious, you ship, and you hold yourself to a high standard of quality even when agents are doing the heavy lifting.

WHY CV.AI

* Build production systems for real clients at the cutting edge of agentic AI.
* Join small, high-impact teams where your contributions are visible and valued from day one.
* Work a hybrid schedule from our offices near the shops and restaurants of the Galleria and Addison. Some of our coolest work happens in the real world.
* Work with a leadership team that uses agents daily and practices what it preaches. Yes, an agent helped write this posting, and a human edited it.
* Gain exposure to a diverse range of industries and technical challenges. No two engagements are the same.
* Earn competitive W2 compensation with a firm that invests in long-term relationships with its engineers.

Computer Visionaries (CV.AI)

Dallas, TX

jobs.title: Wireless and Edge AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

At Booz Allen, we power possibility for our clients facing their toughest challenges. Our cross-domain team of consultants, technologists, researchers, engineers, and cyber experts builds innovative solutions for the infrastructure and capabilities of tomorrow. We're trusted partners on our clients' most critical missions, and we bring expertise to the table, but it's our attitude, our courage, curiosity, and passion for tomorrow, that makes us unique.

  

We're seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join a team building a converged platform that runs real-time wireless signal processing and AI inference on the same GPU-accelerated hardware. You will develop, optimize, and deploy models that run alongside live network workloads, where latency budgets are measured in microseconds and compute is shared with the radio stack. The work spans the full lifecycle: data pipelines from network telemetry, model training and benchmarking, GPU-optimized inference, and containerized deployment on Kubernetes in a hands-on lab.

  

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, train, and evaluate ML models for wireless network use cases, including traffic prediction, anomaly detection, interference classification, resource scheduling, and energy optimization, using network telemetry, KPIs, and RF data captured in the lab
* Build data pipelines that ingest, label, and version telemetry from the network stack, such as performance counters, logs, packet captures, and I/Q samples, into reproducible training datasets
* Optimize trained models for real-time inference on GPU-accelerated edge servers: quantization, pruning, TensorRT or ONNX Runtime conversion, CUDA profiling, and latency and throughput benchmarking against hard targets
* Package and deploy models as containerized inference services on Kubernetes using NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, the NVIDIA GPU Operator, and MIG or time-sliced GPU sharing alongside live network workloads
* Develop AI-driven network applications such as xApps and rApps that consume network telemetry and return control decisions through standardized interfaces, and validate them end to end in the lab
* Instrument the platform with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registry, automated retraining triggers, drift monitoring, and CI/CD for model deployment
* Benchmark GPU resource contention between signal processing and AI inference workloads, and characterize and document the operating envelope for co-location on a single platform
* Apply security and assurance practices to the ML lifecycle: model provenance, dataset lineage, adversarial robustness testing, and alignment with DoD AI assurance guidance
* Write and maintain technical documentation, including model cards, training and deployment procedures, benchmark reports, and reproducibility guides, concurrently with lab work, not after the fact
* Collaborate with network, RF, and cybersecurity engineers to translate mission requirements into models that run on the deployed system, and brief results to government stakeholders
  

Join us. The world can't wait.

  

**You Have:**

* 3+ years of experience training and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including exporting models to formats such as ONNX for deployment
* 3+ years of experience with software development in Python, including production-quality code, testing, and version control practices
* Experience optimizing and benchmarking trained neural networks for inference: latency and throughput measurement, profiling, and techniques such as quantization or pruning
* Experience with GPU computing, including CUDA, cuDNN, or GPU-accelerated libraries, and with NVIDIA driver and container tooling in a Linux server environment
* Experience deploying ML models as services in containerized environments such as Docker or Kubernetes, and building data pipelines for time-series or telemetry data, including feature engineering and dataset versioning
* Experience delivering in an Agile, cross-functional engineering team and resolving complex problems with limited direction
* Ability to work hands-on in a fast-paced lab environment with hard delivery deadlines
* Ability to produce clear, accurate technical documentation and brief results to technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and 5+ years of experience in AI/ML or Automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and Kubernetes, Master's degree in a STEM field and 3+ years of experience in AI/ML or Automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and Kubernetes, or 8+ years of experience in AI/ML or Automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and Kubernetes in lieu of a degree
  

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with RF theory, digital signal processing, or physical-layer algorithms, such as channel estimation, beamforming, and modulation classification, including GNU Radio or MATLAB
* Experience with AI-RAN or AI-native wireless platforms: NVIDIA Aerial, GPU-accelerated Layer 1, or AI/ML-based RAN optimization
* Experience with O-RAN architectures, including the RAN Intelligent Controller Near-RT and Non-RT RIC, xApp/rApp development, and the E2 and A1 interfaces
* Experience with 5G/LTE network KPIs, performance counters, and telemetry, such as 3GPP performance management data, as ML training inputs
* Experience deploying and optimizing large language models (LLMs) for inference using frameworks such as vLLM or NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, including GPU memory optimization, latency, and throughput benchmarking
* Experience with a range of neural network architectures, including transformers, graph neural networks, and reinforcement learning for control and scheduling problems
* Experience with C/C++ or other systems programming languages for performance-critical applications or GPU-accelerated computing
* Experience with MLOps platforms and tooling, including MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, or equivalent

We are seeking a Infrastructure Engineer - SRE who will ensure security applications are delivered with strong SDLC discipline and measurable reliability. This role partners closely with Product Owners and engineering leadership to challenge assumptions, sharpen the Definition of Done, and bake SRE requirements into design and build phases. * Lead and participate in critical incident response (including outside business hours when needed); drive post-incident reviews and resilience improvements. Monitor delivery health and operational KPIs; lead continuous improvement across teams and products
* Oversee capacity planning and resilience management for large-scale, distributed systems, Partner with engineering on public cloud best practices (AWS or equivalent) for compute, storage, networking, messaging, automation (CloudFormation, Terraform), and data services.
* Build a culture of collaboration, reliability, and continuous improvement; coach teams to adopt DevOps and SRE principles. **Software Engineer: Networking & Hardware-in-the-Loop**
========================================================

First Order Effects · Austin, TX

**Who We Are**
--------------

First Order Effects (FOE) is building America's Infrastructure Prime for the robotic era. Autonomous ships, drones, and robots are rewriting how the world moves, fights, and builds - but none of them work without infrastructure to power them, connect them, and launch and recover them. That's what we build.

**We've Built Cutting Edge Systems at Legendary Companies**
-----------------------------------------------------------

Our team comes from SpaceX, Anduril, Saronic, Lockheed Skunk Works, Forterra, and Fuse Energy. Before founding FOE, we built satellite ground stations that closed a national comms gap in days, deployed multi-megawatt power systems at commercial speed, and shipped autonomous surface vessels into Navy fleet production. We've built infrastructure at lightspeed before - now we're applying that playbook to an entire company.

**The Role**
------------

* Own the network inside Surge Hub, our rapidly deployable power system. Take today's early design and turn it into a secure, production-ready architecture.
* Segment traffic so control traffic stays isolated, while the devices that need internet connectivity get a clean, secure path out.
* Build for uptime: backup WAN, failover, and a network that holds when a link drops in the field.
* Design with security in mind from the first switch, not as a retrofit.
* Own the hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test network in our Austin warehouse. Bring every Surge Hub component onto one test network and drive it with your code.
* Write portable test and automation software for Surge Hub and its test equipment, and integrate it with the product's C/C++ firmware and software.
* Build it from the ground up. You pick the equipment, set the architecture, and own the result.

We're hiring early-career engineers to build the next generation of automotive retail software — the platforms dealerships use to sell, finance, and service vehicles, and consumers use to shop for and buy their cars.

Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join the MTIA (Meta Training & Inference Accelerator) Software Tooling team, which develops and maintains the tooling ecosystem for Meta's in-house AI accelerator ASICs. The Tooling team provides debugging, profiling, memory analysis, and monitoring capabilities for the whole MTIA Ecosystem, redefining ML accelerator tooling by leveraging Meta's full-stack ownership from silicon specs to fleet observability.In this role, you will design, build, and maintain developer tools that help engineers debug, profile, measure, and monitor AI workloads running on MTIA hardware at scale. You will work at the intersection of compilers, runtime, hardware, and ML frameworks, collaborating with cross-functional partners to deliver a high-quality developer experience for Meta's custom AI accelerators.

* Partner with internal product teams across advertising, recommendations, and generative AI to understand developer pain points and improve tool usability

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 2+ years of experience in software engineering, with exposure to systems software, developer tooling, or infrastructure
* Proficiency in C++ and Python, including systems-level programming concepts

* Track record of independently delivering software projects from design through production deployment

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test with an interest in embedded firmware to join our IoT (Internet of Things) group. The group develops software for the microcontroller-based sensor hardware designed and manufactured in-house. Our products offer an interesting engineering challenge: microcontrollers with just a few hundred kilobytes of RAM and code space must collect data from sensors such as accelerometers and GPS, communicate with back-end systems over the Internet and nearby devices with Bluetooth, perform over-the-air upgrades with new firmware, and manage cryptographically-secured storage — all while using so little power that they can run for years on a battery.

CMT is looking for a **Software Engineer in Test II, Embedded Firmware** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

**Responsibilities:**

* Use independent judgment and responsibility to contribute to the development and maintenance of test infrastructure for firmware validation under the guidance of senior engineers
* Execute and monitor firmware test runs across simulated firmware on Linux servers and real firmware on device
* Write and maintain automated tests to improve coverage and enhance failure visibility
* Use Python for test harnesses and scripting, with exposure to C for understanding firmware under test
* Use Linux for development and git for source code management
* Learn and apply knowledge of embedded microcontroller systems as it relates to firmware testing
* Assist with test systems attached to equipment capable of measuring parameters like power usage • Gain familiarity with microcontroller circuit boards (e.g., Arduino-like devices), multimeters, benchtop power supplies, and electronic schematics
* Support web services for test coordination and result display, leveraging knowledge of REST APIs and web application development

* Complete any additional tasks as they arise

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of relevant working experience
* Proficiency in Python programming; willingness to read and understand C
* Comfortable working on the Linux command-line and performing basic system administration tasks
* Experience writing and running automated tests, ideally in a CI environment
* Familiarity with git and standard development workflows
* Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) is a plus
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills

jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

**Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting**

**The Data Science Team** at New Balance is the center of excellence for data science across all aspects of our global retail business. We create value for New Balance through actionable data, engaging insights, and transformative AI technology. Data scientists at New Balance use a wide variety of techniques to make a positive impact in all aspects of the sport and fashion retail business including demand planning, customer service, marketing, ecommerce, and supply chain.

* Masters or PhD in a technical field.

Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. **Required**

* 3–5 years of professional software development experience.

**About the Role**  
  
Agentic Pods is building a new model for how Engineering partners with teams across Uber to transform work with AI. Our engineers embed directly with operational teams to understand complex workflows, reimagine how that work could operate in an agentic-first world, and build the production systems that make that future real.  
  
We are looking for an Agentic Software Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade agentic systems and processes that improve complex operational workflows.  
  
This role combines backend engineering, reliability engineering, and a forward-deployed working model. You will work directly with operators and domain experts to discover opportunities, determine where agents can safely help, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable software.  
  
You will own solutions from discovery through architecture, implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation.  
  
**What You Will Do**  
  
**Discover and Build Agentic Systems**  

* Embed with operational teams to understand workflows and identify where agentic AI, deterministic software, automation, or human decision-making can meaningfully improve how work gets done.
* Design, build, and iterate on production agentic systems, including agents, skills, backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and human-in-the-loop workflows, alongside real users.

  
**Own Production Reliability**  

* Define reliability and quality targets and build observability across agent decisions, model behavior, dependencies, and workflow outcomes through tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, fallbacks, and recovery.
* Own systems in production, using incidents, operational data, and user outcomes to continuously improve performance, resilience, and reliability.

  
**Make Agents Safe and Measurable**  

* Define evaluations and validation approaches for task completion, output quality, tool selection, policy compliance, and failure handling across offline testing, controlled rollouts, and production monitoring.
* Build appropriate controls—including permissions, approvals, auditability, data minimization, reversible execution, and human escalation—and partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Data to ensure consequential actions are safe, explainable, and recoverable.

  
**Build for Reuse and Scale**  

* Identify capabilities that should become reusable skills, shared services, platform components, or standard integration patterns, supporting business and regional differences through configuration rather than unnecessary system forks.
* Establish common contracts and contribute to architecture, tooling, deployment patterns, reliability practices, and technical standards that enable Agentic Pods to build and scale consistently.

  
**Who Thrives on This Team**  
  
We're looking for engineers with strong technical depth who are comfortable operating in ambiguity and working directly with users.  

* **Agentic-first thinker:** You naturally look for opportunities to redesign workflows around what's newly possible.
* **0 1 builder:** You move quickly from ambiguous problems to working software.
* **Product-minded:** You have strong judgment about what is useful and worth building, not just what is technically possible.
* **Systems thinker:** You recognize when individual solutions should become reusable capabilities or standards.
* **Adaptable communicator:** You learn unfamiliar domains quickly, build trust, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

  
**Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field OR 1-year full-time Software Engineering work experience, WHICH INCLUDES 1-year total technical software engineering experience in one or more of the following areas:

The year of specialized experience is not necessarily in addition to the years of education and full-time work experience indicated.*

**Preferred Qualifications**

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
new_jobs.description:
Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi-stage work reliably and at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users.

The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress.

The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM-backed applications, AI agents, or agent-based systems in production**.

You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems.

**Remote Work Eligibility**  
This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.**

Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements.

### **Engineering Environment**

The engineering problems addressed by this team include:

* **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long-running, multi-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work.
* **Multi-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover.
* **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi-step work.
* **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior.
* **Testing non-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior.
* **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured-output validation, automated evaluation, domain-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output.
* **Human-in-the-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution.
* **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets.
* **Production service architecture:** Go-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user-facing applications.
* **Secure ingestion:** Processing user-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries.

### **Two Engineering Emphases**

Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas:

### **Platform and Pipeline**

Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed-systems and reliability challenges.

### **Agents and Quality**

Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end-to-end output quality.

This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement.

Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required.

### **Essential Functions**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate **production-quality software and backend services**, primarily using **Go (Golang)**.
* Architect and build **AI agents and agent-based systems** capable of using tools, interacting with APIs, maintaining state and context, and executing complex multi-step workflows.
* Design durable workflows that can **checkpoint, resume, retry, recover, and safely continue execution following partial failures or system interruptions**.
* Determine how **models, agents, tools, APIs, data sources, services, and deterministic application logic** should divide responsibilities within an AI system, including recognizing when an AI model is not the appropriate solution.
* Design integrations across multiple AI model providers, including routing, failover, rate-limit management, health monitoring, and degradation strategies.
* Build safeguards including structured-output validation, error handling, retries, quality gates, evidence validation, and automated recovery mechanisms.
* Develop testing stra

new_jobs.description:
**About North Cloud**

The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them.

At North, we’re building the next-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money.

Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud.

**About the Role**
==================

Forecasting sits underneath much of North: projected spend, budgets, and the commitment purchases we make on customers' behalf all depend on knowing where a customer's usage is headed. When a forecast is off, customers feel it, either in missed savings or in commitments that go unused.

You'll join the Services team and own the models behind North's internal forecasting service, working with your teammates on the service that delivers forecasts across North's features. You'll shape how the service evolves, from how models are trained and evaluated to how forecast quality is monitored in production. You'll also work closely with data scientists and the teams who rely on forecasts, so results are clear to the people making decisions from them.

We're hiring for this role without a fixed level. We'll level you based on experience and on how you work, using our engineering ladder.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and improve the time series models behind projected spend, budgets, and commitment recommendations, across customers with very different sizes and usage patterns.
* Partner with your Services teammates to take models into production as a reliable shared service with clear interfaces.
* Shape the forecasting service's architecture, including how models are trained, versioned, evaluated, and served.
* Improve how we evaluate, backtest, and monitor forecast accuracy over time.
* Build proactive detection and alerting for unusual forecasts and model drift, so issues surface before they affect a decision.
* Quantify forecast uncertainty, such as with prediction intervals, so the features that use forecasts can account for it.
* Work with data scientists to turn forecast results and model changes into findings product and business teams can act on.
* Work with the Commitments, Visibility, and Data teams on what each feature needs from a forecast.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of software or machine learning engineering experience, including shipping time series models to production and owning them after launch.
* Deep experience with time series forecasting across classical statistical methods and machine learning approaches, and judgment about when each fits.
* Experience with time-aware validation, backtesting, and forecast accuracy metrics, and an understanding of their tradeoffs.
* Experience monitoring production models, including drift, anomaly detection, and retraining.
* Fluency in Python and SQL, and experience with large datasets.
* Experience collaborating with data scientists, and explaining model behavior and uncertainty to people outside engineering.
* Pragmatic, informed use of AI coding tools.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience working as a data scientist, or doing analysis work alongside ML engineering.
* Experience with probabilistic forecasting.
* Experience forecasting usage, demand, or spend across many accounts with different patterns.
* Experience with cloud usage, billing, or pricing data.
* Experience with AWS ML services.
* Familiarity with FinOps concepts.

**Work Setup**

Hybrid role based in New York City, with an office in Dumbo, Brooklyn

Team members typically work in the office 2–3 days per week

OR Remote US

* Unlimited PTO
* 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay)
* Two company-wide breaks per year: one around Labor Day and one at the end of the year
* Aetna Medical plan with the majority of the premium covered by North
* Dental and vision insurance
* Flexible spending account (FSA) for health expenses and commuter benefits

Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Engineer reports to the Head Scientist and builds and maintains the systems that let the team's scientists run their studies correctly, reproducibly, and at scale. The scientists design the studies and define the measurements; you make sure every experiment executes exactly as designed, that results can be reproduced from stored inputs, and that research code stays in step with the shipped product. The ideal candidate has supported scientists in an academic computational social science lab or a comparable research setting and has hands-on experience engineering systems built on large language models.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the evaluation infrastructure that tests competing modeling approaches, so that new tests can be set up quickly, run concurrently and automatically, and be monitored.
* Implement measurement pipelines exactly as specified by the scientists, with deterministic and traceable outputs.
* Maintain versioned evaluation datasets with held-out sets that are never used for training.
* Build and maintain data pipelines for human-participant data, external datasets, and model training data, including linkage of records belonging to the same participant across sources.
* Keep research code in step with the production product so that validated improvements ship promptly.
* Detect and prevent threats to the validity of evaluations.
* Track compute and API spend across experiments and their implications for production-stage costs
* Manage repositories, code review, documentation, and the reproducibility of the team's coding workflow.
* Identify implementation choices that can be made more correct or more efficient, and propose changes.

**Qualifications**

* Several years of software engineering experience, including experience supporting researchers in a lab or comparable setting.
* Experience translating specific scientific requirements and experiment designs into code.
* Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines on human behavior data, and confirming that the pipelines matched the criteria and design the researchers specified.
* Strong Python, including the ability to read and audit code produced by agentic coding tools.
* Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, tabular data, and Git-based workflows.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and with running many jobs concurrently.
* Working understanding of machine learning, including how transformer-based language models behave, how model APIs are used, and what fine-tuning involves.
* A habit of writing deterministic, reproducible, cost-aware, and well-documented code.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Hands-on experience engineering large language model systems: prompt pipelines, evaluation harnesses, embedding computation, agentic systems, and/or fine-tuning infrastructure.
* Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on multi-GPU hardware.
* Experience serving open-weight models with an inference framework such as vLLM or SGLang, including batched inference and prefix caching for many requests that share a common prompt.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads.
* Experience with survey or panel data and data collection platforms.
* Experience extracting and storing model activations for downstream analysis.
* Experience with experiment tracking and cost monitoring for machine learning workloads, including GPU provisioning across cloud providers.
* Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

At Booz Allen, we power possibility for our clients facing their toughest challenges. Our cross-domain team of consultants, technologists, researchers, engineers, and cyber experts builds innovative solutions for the infrastructure and capabilities of tomorrow. We're seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join a team building a converged platform that runs real-time wireless signal processing and AI inference on the same GPU-accelerated hardware. You will develop, optimize, and deploy models that run alongside live network workloads, where latency budgets are measured in microseconds and compute is shared with the radio stack. We're hiring early-career engineers to build the next generation of automotive retail software — the platforms dealerships use to sell, finance, and service vehicles, and consumers use to shop for and buy their cars.
